repos_data.description: Agenta is a workspace where you and your team build agents and automations.
Open-source observability for AI agents. Find where your agents fail, dispatch your coding agent to fix it, and verify the fix against real traces.

See what your coding agent actually did. A desktop pal and notch for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and any agent: test results read from the output, faked passes caught, and an MCP server any AI tool can ask. New: talk to Blu, who sees your screen, draws on it as it explains and uses your apps.
Open-source observability and audit trail platform for AI agents. MCP-native, tamper-evident event logging, real-time dashboard.
Accountability infrastructure for long-running AI agents. Self-hosted MCP server: identity, claims and evidence, review, outcomes, and reconstruction across agent runtimes.

When a tool or model call fails, your agent learns what fixed it for other agents, or that nothing has. Plugins for Claude Code and OpenCode, an MCP proxy, a Python wrapper. Open source, metadata only.
Capture local AI agent traces and inspect failures, approvals, token usage, and run regressions through MCP.
